title: POSITIONS_SNAPSHOT message (MBin to MTap, v1, draft)
description: Every open position in every account, by account alias. Gives MTap what it needs to produce exits and to fast-poll held symbols. State message: the newest snapshot_seq wins. Stream mbin:evt:POSITIONS_SNAPSHOT. See mtap-mbin-protocol.md section 8.4.

snapshot_seq.description: Increments on every publish, heartbeats included, so each publish has a fresh _key. Persisted, so it keeps rising across MBin restarts.

as_of_ts_utc.description: When the positions were last reconciled with the broker.

stale.description: True when MBin's prices or broker sync are older than its staleness threshold.

account_alias.description: Account by role (D17). Account numbers and accountIdKey never cross the boundary.

position_key.description: Opaque and stable while the position is open. Never derived from an account number or accountIdKey.

qty.description: Shares or contracts; negative only for a short position.

avg_entry_price.description: Dollars, as the broker quotes it: per share for EQ, premium per share for OPTN (one contract is 100 shares).

high_since_entry.description: Highest last_price seen since the entry; feeds trailing exits.

target_pct.description: As recorded on the opening order (D27).

resting.description: True when the stop order is confirmed open at the broker.

rec_id.description: The RECOMMENDATION that opened it, when MBin opened it from one.

origin.description: Who opened it: an autonomy rule, an operator approval in MBin, the emergency kit, or outside MBin.

auto_exit_enabled.description: Whether MBin may act on an exit for this position without the operator. Otherwise exits are highlighted only.
